verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents official Python, TypeScript, Go, and Java SDKs. The official langsmith-sdk GitHub repo shows usage such as wrap_openai, and the docs describe adding tracing via the SDK. A community comment confirms hands-on use of the @traceable decorator, though it notes that capturing extra context takes more work. missing for 10: in-depth per-language SDK reference documentation in the evidence, corroboration of Go/Java SDK maturity beyond a single mention.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: integrate LangSmith with any agent stack using our Python, Typescript, Go, or Java SDKs
